confirmed_items.title: Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC)
confirmed_items.details: QR Code arrival registration verified. Display on mobile upon passing BKK Suvarnabhumi immigration.

confirmed_items.title: Sukhon Hotel Bangkok
confirmed_items.location: Phaya Thai / Ratchathewi, Bangkok (BTS Phaya Thai Exit 2)
confirmed_items.details: Direct Airport Rail Link connection. Ideal for quick check-in after arrival before luggage drop.

confirmed_items.title: AIRPORTELs BKK Luggage Storage (Suvarnabhumi Basement)
confirmed_items.location: Suvarnabhumi Airport Floor B (Airport Rail Link Level, next to ticket counter)
confirmed_items.details: 1x Large Checked Suitcase deposited for 12 days (Sep 12-24). Strictly 55L clamshell backpack only in Vietnam. Pick up immediately upon HAN arrival at 14:35.

confirmed_items.title: Bangkok (BKK) -> Hanoi (HAN)
confirmed_items.details: Travel Party: Traveler + Friend. Carry-on backpacks only. Meet driver outside column 10 for Old Quarter transfer.

confirmed_items.title: Vietnam E-Visa (Single Entry 30 Days)
confirmed_items.details: Valid for entry at Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport (HAN). Two printed physical copies kept in waterproof sleeve.

confirmed_items.title: Hanoi to Ha Giang VIP Limousine Cabin Bus
confirmed_items.details: Private cabin sleeper with USB charger, AC, and easy-rider team rendezvous.

confirmed_items.title: Ha Giang 3D/2N Licensed Easy-Rider Expedition Pass
confirmed_items.details: 2x Licensed local easy-riders, 2x full-face DOT helmets, elbow/knee armor, rain ponchos, gas, and border permits.

confirmed_items.title: Ha Giang to Sa Pa VIP Mountain Minibus
confirmed_items.details: Direct mountain transfer via Lao Cai highway.

confirmed_items.title: Sa Pa to Cat Ba Island Direct Luxury Express
confirmed_items.details: Combined sleeper coach, Tan Vu expressway, speedboat ferry to Cat Ba island without luggage transfer hassle.

confirmed_items.title: Lan Ha Bay & Ba Trai Dao Private Small-Group Boat & Kayak Pass
confirmed_items.details: Avoids Halong crowds; includes twin sea kayaks, cave tunnels, floating fishing village lunch, and swim stops.

confirmed_items.title: Cat Ba Island to Ninh Binh (Tam Coc) Express Bus
confirmed_items.details: Includes island ferry and direct drop-off at Tam Coc retreat.

confirmed_items.title: Ninh Binh to Hanoi Old Quarter Limousine Van
confirmed_items.details: 9-seater luxury business van with massage seats.

confirmed_items.title: Hanoi (HAN) -> Bangkok (BKK)
confirmed_items.details: Friend departs/separates. Traveler retrieves checked suitcase from AIRPORTELs Floor B. Meets girlfriend in BKK terminal.

confirmed_items.title: Bangkok (BKK) -> Koh Samui (USM) Direct Flight Price Radar
confirmed_items.recommended_target: Bangkok Airways PG 169 (17:15 PM) - Perfect 2h40m buffer after HAN landing & bag retrieval
confirmed_items.price_alert_window: Buy 6 to 8 weeks before departure (Mid-July to Early August 2026). Bangkok Airways locks seat sales in Web Saver buckets that sell out 3 weeks prior.
confirmed_items.details: Direct nonstop flight (1 hr 05 min). Free boutique lounge access at BKK Concourse A/F. Includes 20kg checked baggage.

confirmed_items.title: Lomprayah High-Speed Catamaran: Koh Samui -> Koh Phangan
confirmed_items.details: 20-minute smooth high-speed catamaran cruise. VIP air-con deck.

confirmed_items.title: Lomprayah High-Speed Catamaran: Koh Phangan -> Koh Tao
confirmed_items.details: 1-hour scenic crossing. Hotel shuttle pickup arranged at Mae Haad.

confirmed_items.title: Koh Tao to Bangkok VIP Transit (Lomprayah + Flight)
confirmed_items.details: Morning catamaran to Samui Pralarn Pier -> Bangkok Airways PG 148 to BKK Suvarnabhumi.

confirmed_items.title: Bangkok (BKK) -> Tel Aviv (TLV) via Abu Dhabi (AUH)
confirmed_items.departure: Etihad Airways / International Partner via AUH
